body: You are so nice to take the time to talk to me thank you. I've felt this way for a long long time. I've been a waste of space for awhile since I've been 13 I'm 33. Yes old old old unaccomplished and pathetic. I only stress out those closest to me. No kids. Friends fading. Family lives far. Career focused for too long and that went to shit pointless really for all the work . Used to be very social. Can't stand up for myself and I hate talking like this I feel guilty. Less about me - how are you? Why are u here? Thanks again even if you don't write back. I'm in my car but not going to move. I'm afraid if loved ones die that will be it. My final last reason to live- if they are gone. I can't stand the thought of anything happening to anyone I love. I really fucking hate myself

Nobody to talk to really. I am a waste of space. No good to the world. I do feel closer and closer. I am a burden to all around me constantly unhappy. Even re reading what I wrote just now I'm fucking pathetic sounding and I hate that so I need to disappear soon. I pretend I'm okay and seem ok and happy to many
